<style>
/* Skin visual do validador alinhada Ã  estÃ©tica principal do site Tsiino. */
:root{
  --tsiino-ink:#2E3B24;
  --tsiino-moss:#626A38;
  --tsiino-brown:#704023;
  --tsiino-red:#6E1F1D;
  --tsiino-cream:#FFFDF7;
  --tsiino-paper:#F7F1E8;
  --tsiino-line:rgba(46,59,36,.16);
  --tsiino-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(24,29,18,.14);
}

body{ background: var(--tsiino-cream); }

.hv-modern-page{
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--tsiino-ink);
}

.hv-site-hero{
  position: relative;
  min-height: clamp(620px, 86vh, 860px);
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw);
  padding: clamp(7rem, 12vw, 11rem) clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem) clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  display: grid;
  align-items: end;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16,18,12,.84) 0%, rgba(30,37,23,.62) 42%, rgba(30,37,23,.18) 100%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,18,12,.06), rgba(16,18,12,.52)),
    url('../../figures/conservacao/herbario.png'),
    url('../../figures/conservacao/herbarium_blitz.jpg'),
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--tsiino-ink), var(--tsiino-moss));
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  color: #fff;
}

.hv-site-hero::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:auto 0 0 0;
  height: 150px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,253,247,0), var(--tsiino-cream));
  pointer-events:none;
}

.hv-site-hero-inner{
  position: relative;
